slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single slot at EEPROM blocks 0-25 (logical 0x00-0xCF). Reader FUN_08010a70 validates length XOR pair first, then payload byte-sum XOR pair; on any failure caller FUN_080115f0 rewrites the slot from RAM defaults via FUN_08010c94. No backup slot: bytes 0xD0-0x1FF are 0xFF in both samples.

checksums.name: payload_byte_sum
checksums.formula_detail: sum = sum of unsigned payload bytes buf[0x10:length] accumulated in u32 by FUN_08010c94 while serializing; stored u32 LE at logical 0x00 and as sum^0xDEADBEEF at logical 0x04. Covered range logical [0x10,0xD0). Byte sum invariant under per-8-byte-block reversal, so also sum of physical sav[0x10:0xD0].

checksums.name: sum_xor_redundancy
checksums.formula_detail: stored u32 LE at logical 0x04 = payload_byte_sum XOR 0xDEADBEEF (mask is _DAT_08010f80 in FUN_08010c94, value forced by both samples). Reader checks (computed_sum XOR mask) == stored. Physical image at sav 0x00-0x03 (block-reversed); packet probe at physical 0x2 hits this field.

checksums.name: length_xor_redundancy
checksums.formula_detail: length u32 LE at logical 0x08 (=208) and length XOR 0x44890100 at logical 0x0C (mask is _DAT_08010f7c). Reader FUN_08010a70 validates this pair from blocks 0-1 before reading payload and uses length for (length+7)>>3 block count.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 transfer helper: programs src/dst and count|0x80000000, busy-polls DMA control. Used for all EEPROM transfers to/from 0x0D000000.

EEPROM read one 8-byte block: address bitstream + 1,1 command bits DMA to 0x0D000000, 0x44 halfwords back, reassembles 4x u16 MSB-first. Call from FUN_08010a70 uses func_ spelling missed by callgraph.
EEPROM write one 8-byte block: expands 4x u16 + address + 0,1 command bits, DMA addr_bits+0x43 halfwords to 0x0D000000, then FUN_0802d9e8 setup, polls EEPROM line, FUN_0802da70 teardown.
Verify: read-back via FUN_0802db34 and compare 4x s16; returns 0 on match, 0x8000 on mismatch.
Write-with-retry: up to 3x (FUN_0802dbe4 + FUN_0802dcc0 verify) per 8-byte block. Caller edge via func_0x0802dd18 spelling, absent from callgraph.json.
Write-completion setup helper from 6-byte config before EEPROM poll; exact peripheral unresolved in Ghidra DATs.
Write-completion teardown: clears control bit set by FUN_0802d9e8.

Serializer+checksum+flush: copies struct+0x54..+0x114 to logical buf 0x10..0xCF accumulating byte sum, writes header at buf 0x00-0x0F, flushes 26 blocks via FUN_0802dd18 under FUN_080231c4/FUN_080231dc guard.
Reader: reads blocks 0-1, validates length XOR pair, reads remaining blocks, validates sum XOR pair, memcpy via FUN_080322ac to struct+0x54..+0x114, post-processes +0x64 and +0x54.
Default initializer for same struct offsets (defaults in report); calls FUN_0802d948(4) and FUN_0802d9b0(2,...). No caller recovered (table dispatch).
Save-media init helper called with 4; exact registers unresolved.
EEPROM type select (type<=3), called with type 2; supplies params struct used by drivers (+4 limit, +8 address bits).
memcpy helper used for all deserialize copies.
